author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Its the battle of the runners today! On one side there's the Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson action thriller about a courier racing against time to deliver a donor organ to a sick kid, and on the other, the Gal Gadot Amazon movie about a woman who has to run across London to save her son. But who will come out on top?
